title: Parser support for PEP 798 in Python 3.15
author: JelleZijlstra
body_preview: ### Summary  The Ruff parser currently has some partial support for PEP 798 (new in Python 3.15); it supports list comprehensions but not other kinds of comprehensions. `[*x for x in y]` is accepted; `{*x for x in y}` is not. title: Fine-grained cache locking
author: zanieb
